# `kernel/arch/i386/isa/ic` — ISA controller chips (8259/8253/8042 style helpers)

<!-- generated by tools/gen_folder_readmes.py -->

## English

This directory contains ISA controller chips (8259/8253/8042 style helpers).

`config.mk` records no directly compiled sources here; the work is in the subdirectories.

These `config.mk` lists are reference metadata from the 4.5BSD tree; the BSD45 build scripts (`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`) select the files that are actually compiled.

## 中文

本目录包含ISA 控制器芯片（8259/8253/8042 风格辅助代码）。

`config.mk` 未记录直接编译的源文件，实际工作在其子目录中。

这些 `config.mk` 清单来自 4.5BSD 源码树，是参考元数据；BSD45 的构建脚本（`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`）会显式选择实际参与编译的文件。
